subject: info-dy
title: (R)INFO.DY.------TH.CONT.
description: Chart on book p. 153 (SR(TRS)II-9). INFO-DY (information dynamics) is the subject, with the (R) prefix, "the reality of"; TH-CONT (thrust continuance) is the partner. From the subject: POL-DY (political dynamics) and WO-EXP-PRI (world expansion principle). From POL-DY: PART (participation). From WO-EXP-PRI: ALT-F (alternative functionalism). From ALT-F: PART-2 (participation). From PART-2: TRNS (transference).
